doc_layout.docs/periodic-checks.md: User-facing docs for periodic subsessions (monitors). Documents: auto-stop vs auto-pause disambiguation (auto-stopped = closed/terminated, auto-paused = reversible, worker alive); blocked-resume threshold detection (3 consecutive blocked resumes auto-close with repeated_blocked reason); auto-stop, auto-pause, and failure notifications (immediate notification with fallback agent_message frame; both states publish SSE notifications); mill-recovery behaviour (exponential backoff when mill is unreachable); and transient-error retry behaviour (configurable exponential backoff for OpenRouter/LLM API hiccups, only PERIODIC subsessions, cycle skipped gracefully when retries exhausted). Three config keys under the 'Transient-error retry behaviour' section: transient_error_max_retries (3), transient_error_backoff_base (1.0s), transient_error_backoff_cap (30.0s). Also documents dual delivery for periodic-spawned decision chats (parent inbox + main-chat reaction), and the exhausted-retry fallback where user_chat retry exhaustion includes the original decision prompt. The 'Paused-monitor resume behaviour (watcher)' section documents two watcher-detected PR states: PR closed without merging (state==closed && merged != true; high-urgency SSE notification + follow-up ticket via BoardClient.create_ticket unless owning ticket is terminal) and merge conflict (mergeable==false; high-urgency SSE notification). Notifications dedup once per condition per subsession.

conventions.changelog: CHANGELOG.md has unreleased section at top; changes listed as markdown bullets.
conventions.changelog_fragments: Each PR adds a fragment under changelog.d/ with pattern YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ-<description>-<random>.misc.md containing a single-line description.
conventions.error_format: Tool error strings start with 'Error:' or 'Refused:' — no trailing punctuation after 'Refused:' lines.
conventions.simple_modules_no_skill_md: Modules that are just a tool factory (no skill markdown loaded into agent context, e.g. render-url, public-fetch) do not have a skill.md or docs/ subdirectory. They are documented entirely via module docstrings picked up by mkdocstrings.
conventions.user_chat_transcript_forwarding: For user_chat subsessions, the delivery includes the full transcript alongside the agent-written summary so the parent assistant can act on operator decisions even when the summary is terse. This is internal plumbing — no user-facing docs changes needed since the visible contract (agent calls complete_subsession(summary)) is unchanged.
conventions.monitor_status_disambiguation: The reaction prompt and SSE notifications distinguish auto-stopped (closed/terminated, worker gone) from auto-paused (reversible, worker alive). The prompt instructs the agent to use 'auto-stopped (closed)' vs 'auto-paused (will resume on message)' phrasing. Both states publish SSE notifications with title 'Monitor auto-paused/stopped: {title}'. Internal reason codes 'no_change_auto_stop' (close) and 'paused' (pause) are never conflated.
conventions.route_docs_auto_generated: Route handler doc pages (e.g. docs/chat/server/routes/mail.md) use the mkdocstrings `::: robotsix_chat.chat.server.routes.<module>` directive to auto-generate endpoint docs from the module docstring. New routes get a stub .md file + a nav entry in mkdocs.yml.
